checks.name: exact-research-route
checks.run:
from mission_control.discovery_http import route
from types import SimpleNamespace
p=['api','apps','sample-one','discovery','review']
h=SimpleNamespace(command='POST',path='/api/apps/sample-one/discovery/review')
try:
    result=route(h,p)
except NotImplementedError:
    result=None
assert result=='review','Exact research route must resolve to its declared operation'
h.path+='?approved=true'
rejected=False
try:
    route(h,p)
except ValueError:
    rejected=True
assert rejected,'Query cannot grant or select research authority'
